description: This file defines an Angular service 'WidgetService' responsible for managing widget-related data, including fetching, saving, updating, deleting widget bundles and widget types, caching widget info, and registering widget configuration components within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: WidgetService
classes.description: Angular service for managing widgets and widget bundles, including CRUD operations, caching, and component registration.

methods.name: getWidgetScopeVariables
methods.description: Returns an array of scope variable names used in widget templates.

methods.name: getAllWidgetsBundles
methods.description: Fetches all widget bundles, utilizing cache if available.

methods.name: getSystemWidgetsBundles
methods.description: Retrieves system widget bundles, utilizing cache.

methods.name: getTenantWidgetsBundles
methods.description: Retrieves tenant widget bundles, utilizing cache.

methods.name: getWidgetBundles
methods.description: Fetches widget bundles with pagination and search options.

methods.name: getWidgetsBundle
methods.description: Retrieves a specific widget bundle by ID.

methods.name: exportWidgetsBundle
methods.description: Exports a widget bundle, including images.

methods.name: saveWidgetsBundle
methods.description: Saves a widget bundle and invalidates cache.

methods.name: updateWidgetsBundleWidgetTypes
methods.description: Updates widget types within a bundle.

methods.name: updateWidgetsBundleWidgetFqns
methods.description: Updates widget FQNs within a bundle.

methods.name: deleteWidgetsBundle
methods.description: Deletes a widget bundle and invalidates cache.

methods.name: getBundleWidgetTypes
methods.description: Retrieves widget types within a bundle.

methods.name: exportBundleWidgetTypesDetails
methods.description: Exports widget type details within a bundle, with resource inclusion option.

methods.name: getBundleWidgetTypeFqns
methods.description: Retrieves widget type FQNs within a bundle.

methods.name: getBundleWidgetTypeInfosList
methods.description: Gets list of widget type info objects within a bundle.

methods.name: getBundleWidgetTypeInfos
methods.description: Fetches widget type info with filtering options.

methods.name: getWidgetType
methods.description: Retrieves widget type by full FQN.

methods.name: saveWidgetTypeDetails
methods.description: Saves widget type details and updates cache.

methods.name: saveImportedWidgetTypeDetails
methods.description: Saves imported widget type details, updating cache.

methods.name: getWidgetTypeById
methods.description: Fetches widget type details by ID.

methods.name: exportWidgetType
methods.description: Exports widget type, including resources.

methods.name: getWidgetTypeInfoById
methods.description: Retrieves widget type info by ID.

methods.name: saveWidgetType
methods.description: Saves widget type details.

methods.name: deleteWidgetType
methods.description: Deletes widget type and updates cache.

methods.name: getWidgetTypes
methods.description: Fetches paginated widget types with filters.

methods.name: addWidgetFqnToWidgetBundle
methods.description: Adds a widget FQN to a widget bundle.

methods.name: getWidgetTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves widget template info based on widget type.

methods.name: getWidgetInfoFromCache
methods.description: Gets widget info from in-memory cache.

methods.name: putWidgetInfoToCache
methods.description: Stores widget info in cache.

methods.name: registerBasicWidgetConfigComponents
methods.description: Registers basic widget config components from a module.

methods.name: getBasicWidgetSettingsComponentBySelector
methods.description: Retrieves a basic widget config component by selector.

methods.name: putBasicWidgetSettingsComponentToMap
methods.description: Stores a basic widget config component by selector.

methods.name: registerWidgetSettingsComponents
methods.description: Registers widget settings components from a module.

methods.name: getWidgetSettingsComponentTypeBySelector
methods.description: Retrieves a widget settings component by selector.

methods.name: putWidgetSettingsComponentToMap
methods.description: Stores a widget settings component by selector.

methods.name: widgetTypeUpdated
methods.description: Updates cache when a widget type is modified.

methods.name: deleteWidgetInfoFromCache
methods.description: Removes widget info from cache by FQN.

methods.name: getWidgetsBundlesByIds
methods.description: Fetches multiple widget bundles by their IDs.

methods.name: loadWidgetsBundleCache
methods.description: Loads widget bundle cache if not already loaded.

methods.name: invalidateWidgetsBundleCache
methods.description: Clears widget bundle cache.
